# Largest robot championships

[ Contact an Account Manager ](https://business.guinnessworldrecords.com/contact-us?source=Website-EN-B2B%20Form) [ Apply Now ](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/account/application/begin/15-83849) Who
    ENJOY AI Organizing Committee What
     16,399 total number  Where
     China (Shanghai)  When
     From 14 to 15 December 2024 
The largest robot championships consists of 16,399 teams and was achieved by ENJOY AI Organizing Committee (China) at ENJOY AI 2024 Global Final in Shanghai, China, from 14 to 15 December 2024.
ENJOYAI is a global robotics competition held by the Federation of Global Youth Artificial Intelligence, a US non-profit organization. According to the organizer, 17,036 teams with 28,460 participants from 34 countries and regions involved in the competition. The Guinness World Records attempt was designed as a part of the two-day competition.
Records change on a daily basis and are not immediately published online. For a full list of record titles, please use our Record Application Search. (You will need to register / login for access)
